Name: The Ashbringer
Author: Pokcmvmxckm
Description:
Wield the Blade of the Scarlet Highlord and smite the foul undead with holy fury!

To Install the mod;

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3064]SMAPI[/url]
2. install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]3. Download and unzip the mod into "Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods" folder
4. Run the game with SMAPI to generate the Config file
5. Enjoy as is, or open the Config to change between Corrupted and Uncorrupted sprites

By default the galaxy Sword is set to the Uncorrupted Sprite while the Infinity Blade is set to the Corrupted Sprite. The Alternate option reverses the sprites, so the Galaxy Sword is the Corrupted Sprite while the Infinity Blade will have the Uncorrupted sprite.

This is my first mod and I'm genuinely surprised I got it working on my game, so if you have any problems let me know.

Manifest.Name: Ashbringer
Manifest.Description: Replaces the Galaxy Sword and Infinity Blade with the Ashbringer or the Corrupted Ashbringer from World of Warcraft.
Manifest.Author: Pokcmvmxckm
